rationale: Jiale brings production ML infrastructure expertise from Meta and Uber—deep learning systems, distributed training, and scalable platforms—while Alex is actively building foundational ML skills through bootcamp programs in the same Bay Area region. This is a natural mentor-mentee pairing where Jiale can offer concrete guidance on the systems engineering side of ML, and Alex's hands-on bootcamp work represents the early-career perspective Jiale regularly interacts with at scale.
intro_message: Jiale Zhi, meet Alex — a fullstack developer and ML bootcamp student in the Bay Area who'd benefit from your perspective on building scalable ML infrastructure.
